name: The Voting Game
summary: A party game where players anonymously vote for who best fits revealing questions to earn majority votes.
rules_text: Each player gets a colored ID and white voting cards numbered for all other players. On a turn, the asker draws a black question card and reads it. All players simultaneously and anonymously vote using a white card for who best fits the question. The asker collects and reveals votes. Then in order left of the asker, each player who received votes may guess one voter; if correct the vote is revealed. If any player receives at least half of the votes cast, that player keeps the black question card as a point. Play passes left. The first player to collect 6 black cards wins. Alternative scoring awards points to voters who were part of the majority.
rating_reason: Social voting party game, simultaneous votes, talk, bluffing, arithmetic winner.
